why: static entity storage plus one session: a node is created ON the executor (`rclc_executor_node_init(executor, node, name, options)`) and lands in the executor's node table (`NROS_EXECUTOR_MAX_NODES`), so it cannot exist before one or be moved between two. rcl builds a node from an `rcl_context_t` and rclc adds it nowhere; see `cpp:Executor::add_node` for the same divergence in C++ and `cpp:Context` for why there is no separate context.
